title: Recto lauds PH's 'successful' ASEAN Summit hosting, urges action on deals
summary: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto on Sunday commended the Philippines" “successful hosting” of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, stressing the need to follow through on agreements reached…

blocks.text: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto on Sunday commended the Philippines’ “successful hosting” of the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, stressing the need to follow through on agreements reached during the meetings.
In a statement, Recto, who chairs the ASEAN National Organizing Council, thanked government agencies and other partners that helped organize the summit.

“Led and guided by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., the Philippines successfully hosted the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, which were international in productive participation and global in positive impact,” Recto said.

“As Chair of the ASEAN National Organizing Council, I salute the hard work and long hours put in by government agencies and partners to carry out the President’s directive of a summit and meetings that showcase our country’s best and the ASEAN spirit of solidarity,” he added.
The Philippines, which holds the rotating chairmanship of ASEAN this year, hosted the 48th and 49th ASEAN Summits in May and November, respectively.
Recto said the summit's success should also be measured by how the agreements reached would benefit the country and its people.
He cited the Philippines' hosting of two new ASEAN centers for creative industries and maritime cooperation as among the key outcomes of the meetings.
“The one for creative industries will incubate great startups. The maritime cooperation center, on the other hand, will help advance negotiations on the South China Sea Code of Conduct,” Recto said.
He noted that despite the hundreds of meetings held during the summit, several key agreements still needed to be finalized and implemented.
“The summit may be over, and the fanfare may have died down. But the work that follows is no less important than the work that brought us here—and deserves no less dedication,” Recto said.
“Maraming salamat sa inyong lahat. Karangalan ng Pilipinas ang tagumpay na ito. At dapat bawat Pilipino ang makinabang sa bunga ng ating pagsisikap,” he added.
(Thank you very much to all of you. This success is an honor for the Philippines. And every Filipino should benefit from the fruits of our hard work.)— MCG, GMA News
